uncertain_sources: The frame at 00:03:18.380 is a transitional board state. It supports the reviewed scale-factor laws but is not treated as a complete statement of the density derivation.
The lecturer obscures part of the writing in the frame at 00:13:39.612. Only visible equations and the box geometry are attributed to the image.

The frame at 00:15:35.600 shows the separated differential equation and only the beginning of log rho. The complete logarithmic result is reconstructed from the immediately preceding algebra and identified as such in the caption.
The board discussion briefly calls an intermediate force expression pressure before dividing by area. The chapter restores that missing step explicitly.
The transcript fragment at 00:44:05--00:44:25 is garbled and unrelated to the surrounding physics, so it is rejected rather than guessed.
The chapter uses the lecture normalization Lambda equals 8 pi G rho zero over 3. A note distinguishes it from the standard Einstein-equation convention Lambda E equals 3 Lambda.
The flat de Sitter big-bang exchange is qualified because the flat coordinate patch is not the complete de Sitter geometry.
Lecture-era observational precision for w is labeled historical rather than presented as a current measurement.
The quoted 10 to the minus 123 vacuum-energy discrepancy is retained with the lecture's warning that the exact exponent depends on convention.
The title card and promotional tail are excluded as non-course material.
